name: N-DGS Bounded Cholesky Parameterization
definition: N-DGS parameterizes the joint covariance using bounded Cholesky coefficients multiplied by query diagonal scales to control spatial extent and cross-covariance.
summary: N-DGS Bounded Cholesky Parameterization is a joint covariance method for 3D Gaussians that avoids costly covariance inversion by implicitly deriving the regression operator from bounded Cholesky coefficients.
